summary: Quote on NIFTY (NSE_INDEX, scrip 999920000, Exch N, ExchType C): ltp, OHLC, ChgPcnt and the trade time.

notes: Frame worked here in 5paisa's MarketFeedV3 shape for an index (no traded quantity, no book: zeros), as the master names indices (scrip codes above 999900 on N/C and B/C).

deviations.reason: 5paisa fills an index's traded quantity and book totals with 0 (an index has no trades and no book); the web passes the zeros on (_quote_fields feed.get("LastQty", 0), feed.get("TBidQ", 0)), the desktop's index frame leaves them out. Web sends zero; docs say leave out.

5paisa sends an index's average price as 0, a price it does not have; the web passes the 0 on (_quote_fields feed.get("AvgRate", 0)), the desktop leaves out a price 0 with nothing held, as for every instrument. An invented zero on the web.
